The window bridge, the input forwarder and the key table of GLFW, the OpenAL binding of LWJGL 3 and the hidden window of the snapshot backends.
Learn: [base-lwjgl3-glfw](/build/base-modules/lwjgl3-glfw/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`GlfwInputForwarder`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-glfw/glfwinputforwarder/) | class | Forwards the input of a GLFW window to the UI bridges of JOID, ahead of the GLFW callbacks the window already had. |
| [`GlfwKeys`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-glfw/glfwkeys/) | class | Maps the key codes of GLFW to the keys of JOID and back, by physical position or through the keyboard layout. |
| [`GlfwSnapshotWindow`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-glfw/glfwsnapshotwindow/) | class | A hidden, undecorated GLFW window of a fixed size, on which the snapshot backends render. |
| [`GlfwWindowBridge`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-glfw/glfwwindowbridge/) | class | The window bridge of a GLFW window, which reads its size, mouse, keys, clipboard and cursor in screen pixels. |
| [`Lwjgl3AlBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-glfw/lwjgl3albinding/) | class | The OpenAL binding of LWJGL 3, given to `AlAudioBridge` by the LWJGL 3 and Vulkan backends. |
